changes.description: Read valid WoW Armory profiles that omit optional stats, including Nytheris Moonwhisper, while preserving strict validation of malformed data
Post an updated bingo board at the bottom of the channel after state changes, keeping previous images as history with a link to the latest board
Recover already-sent board revisions after lost database acknowledgements, prevent duplicate reposts and reject interactions from superseded boards
End bingo automatically when the first row, column or main diagonal is completed; disable further marking and undo, and free the channel for another game
Finalize previously won games during board synchronization without changing snapshots or sending duplicate announcements
Make Mark a cell the primary board button and open its cell selector privately; keep only marking, unmarking, adding phrases and browsing phrases below the image
Keep new-game and end-game management in slash commands while preserving compatibility with previously posted controls
Use buttons below bingo boards to add phrases, browse the phrase pool, start another game and confirm ending the current game
Board actions use private forms and selectors, preserve current permissions, and protect newer games from stale end confirmations
Bingo images now contain only the tiles, with no title, status header, footer or outer frame
Bingo commands now use private, paginated set and phrase selection menus; users no longer need or see database IDs
Selection menus check current permissions and expire after ten minutes; game show refreshes existing boards with the current renderer
Create shared bingo sets with contributor access, phrase pools, ownership transfer and archiving; run independent 3×3, 4×4 or 5×5 games per channel
Mark and unmark cells through Discord dropdowns, announce the first bingo, preserve progress across restarts and restore deleted board messages
Bingo failures include contextual console diagnostics without dumping Discord payloads or database parameters; failed board updates retain saved progress

WoW monitoring now logs check starts, subscription counts and completion summaries even when nothing changes, plus readiness and scheduler-lock skips; nonempty notification batches report delivery, retry and removal totals

WoW character notifications now show before/after values for all changed card data, including profession skills and caps, learned or removed professions, talent points, PvP and character details; notifications are still triggered only by level gains, guild changes or specialization changes
WoW character lookup and observer creation now accept profiles without a guild, such as Lepidoptera Viridis, when Armory omits the guild field

WoW command errors and monitoring failures now log diagnostic causes to the console, including character, request or parsing stage, HTTP status and invalid data fields, without dumping HTTP headers, response bodies or URL credentials
WoW character lookup and observer creation now accept Armory profiles without talent data, such as Nytheris Moonwhisper, instead of reporting that the data format has changed
WoW observer creation now asks only for a character name, previews the profile for confirmation, then offers a dropdown of registered channels with character observation enabled
WoW observation channel selection checks permissions and feature availability again before saving, including when a channel is disabled after opening the menu
/wow character without a name now lets you select a character observed in the current channel; named lookups and the ephemeral option remain available
Removed stats from WoW character cards and translated all WoW responses, field labels, notifications and errors into English
WoW Forever EU integration — check realm status on demand or monitor all EU realm types every 5 minutes, with change notifications sent to a server-configured channel
Monitor forum reports of login and connection problems alongside official realm status, with separate community-report notifications
Look up character profiles and manage personal character observations in channels enabled by bot administrators; administrators can manage all observations on their server
Check observed characters every 15 minutes and notify about level gains, guild changes and specialization changes; initial setup and manual checks do not post automatic channel notifications

ChatGPT payment summary no longer shows the next payment as ~1 month away when the configured payment day hasn't happened yet this period — next payment date is now the nearest upcoming occurrence of that day after the last summary
Fixed several commands (bot init, ChatGPT user add/remove, Steam observer add) silently reporting success even when the underlying database write failed
Message history saving now logs when a save fails instead of failing silently
Removed the unmaintained eslint-plugin-neverthrow dependency — incompatible with the current ESLint/typescript-eslint setup and was never actually enforcing anything
Migrated Gemini integration from the deprecated @google/generative-ai SDK to the actively maintained @google/genai SDK
FitCoach module removed — meal & nutrition tracking, DM meal logging, and related commands are gone (feature was unused)
Upgraded TypeScript, ESLint, TypeORM and other core dependencies to their latest major versions
Resolved breaking changes from the dependency upgrade — build tooling, strict-mode defaults, and a TypeORM query that stopped compiling
Fixed compiled output silently disappearing after a rebuild — a stale incremental build cache was surviving the dist cleanup step
Fixed a startup crash in settings lookup caused by TypeORM's new strict handling of undefined values in queries
Reminder confirmation and error messages are now standardized — same wording every time, whether set via /reminder or by talking to the bot
Steam observer no longer floods the channel with notifications when a private profile becomes public
Long gaps in Steam profile visibility (1 month+) are re-synced silently instead of notifying about every game accumulated during that time
Bot no longer sends duplicate replies when multiple AI features could respond to the same message or DM
Centralized message routing for chat/DM AI features — cleaner, more consistent handling as more features are added
Human must be enabled for any AI-driven @mention feature to respond on a server
Typing indicator now shows while the bot processes a chat or DM reminder request
Reminder notification embed styling unified with the rest of the bot
Reminders module — schedule one-off reminders for yourself
/reminder create, list, and cancel commands — usable in servers and DMs
Ask the bot in chat or DM to set or cancel a reminder in natural language
Reminders are delivered back to wherever they were created — DM or server channel
/changelog command — view bot version history
FitCoach — meal & nutrition tracking module (AI-powered)
Meal logging via DM chat, photos, and /meal add
Nutrition lookup against Open Food Facts & USDA databases
AI estimation for ingredients not found in any database
Meal time ranges and timezone configuration via interactive modals
Daily, weekly, monthly and yearly nutrition summaries
Day summary includes AI-generated nutrition insight
Ask AI in chat to show meal list or summary for any period
Onboarding flow with default or custom meal time presets
Max message character size handling for all embeds
Saved messages search function
Context and tool usage tweaks for AI
Function calling to retrieve conversation context
Configurable context size for humanized module
Steam integration — new game release notifications
Humanized module — AI responds as a human in configured channels
Channel management commands
Guild management commands
2 additional GIF providers with random selection
Better context handling and image compression for AI
AI model updated to Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite
Good morning command now triggers on startsWith
Good morning no longer triggers random reply
Good morning command
ChatGPT subscription payment reminder
ChatGPT settings management commands

Initial release — full command refactor
Docker setup and deployment pipeline
